name: SuperHub
desc:
SuperHub: a calm home screen for Supernote. A framed clock, ten pencil-sketch buttons you name and point at any folder, note, app or SuperHub page, and your recent pages at a glance. Opened from the floating home bubble or the toolbar.

Based on SuperDashboard by AgP42 (MIT licence): https://github.com/AgP42/SuperDashboard

Needs file access, no internet: READ to scan and open your files, WRITE to save settings.
author: weedwhitesandwine (based on SuperDashboard by AgP42)
